feature: Yourrest offline business recording and reconnect synchronization
features: new customer, visit, service registration, and confirmed-source follow-up local save
offline cold reload after online warmup
frozen request replay and atomic durable ACK
preserved device event time and separate server receipt time
account and scope checks before upload
explicit conflict review and retained local archive
limitations: First sign-in and initial device preparation need internet.
Business entry synchronization runs while the application UI is active or reopened; no closed-app background upload promise.
Maps, speech providers, and national address lookup may need internet. GPS requires a real permitted device fix.
Phone storage must remain available; clearing app/browser data before syncing loses device-only entries.
Physical Android/iOS behavior has not been tested here.
A tab interrupted while holding a synchronization lease may defer the next attempt until its bounded 90-second lease expires.
